title: 第5章 练气之道又名曰修仙第6章 师尊难不成是仙
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 密林下方。
萧火火抬头看去。
眼前这位自己刚拜的师尊，不知为何忽然抬起了头，望著天空，眼中闪过一丝惆悵。
正当他不解的时刻，忽然见师尊回过神来。
师尊负手而立，语气幽幽，双眸落在了他的身上，似乎有些怒其不爭的嘆息道：
“许久未曾出世。”
“外界，已经还只剩武者之道了吗？”
听得这有些惆悵的话语，望著身前有些孤傲世间的身影，萧火火顿时大惊，头皮发麻。
他那双望向楚风的眸子，满是震惊和不可思议，似乎听到了什么打破常识的事物一般。
萧火火摇头自疑，就是话语都有些错乱：
“这，根据记载，自古以来不都是武者之道么？”
“难道不成，除了武者之外世间还有什么別的修炼之法？”
他瞪著眼，有些惊疑不定的等著高人的回答。
看到少年这般模样，楚风心中一乐。
很好，这个小子上鉤了。
这番话，小子心里已经信了八九成。
他这个世外高人的身份，也会因为这番顛覆性的言论，在其眼中变得更为坚实。
楚风的神色依旧冷漠，依旧是那一副超然物外的模样，不过，嘴角却隱隱的勾起一丝不屑的轻笑：
“天下道法，分大道，小道。”
“武修之道，终究不过是小道。”
“哪怕是穷极一生，也终究是会受其局限所规束，无法真正迈入真正的巔峰之境。”
“如你所言，武修一道的极限，也不过是所谓的大宗师之境。”
“你们讚嘆的威能，也不过是一人灭军，仅此而已。”
仅此而已？！
这四字如同平地惊雷，炸的簫火火久久不能回神。
他所仰望的，甚至是整个东离城，整个南荒界人所仰慕的超级强者，在师尊眼中，也不过能得这仅此而已的评价？
想到此处，簫火火的呼吸都变得有些急促，双目放光。
凝视著身前的男人。
大宗师都不过仅此而已，那眼前这位，他的师尊又是何等境界？
他难以想像。
楚风咳嗽一声继续道：
“这小道，在大道面前，不值一提。”
闻言，簫火火再也难以自抑激动：
“师尊，那大道，又是何种修炼法门，大道修炼者，又是何等光景？”
看著越来越激动得簫火火，楚风微微笑道：
“这大道啊，便是炼气之道。”
“如能入大道，界时，你所谓的大宗师，在你面前也不过如同孩童一般熟弱。”
炼气之道？
簫火火低头默念著这四个大字，同时也在脑海中不断的搜索著，有关炼气之道的信息。
可他將从小到大看过的书籍，所经歷过的事物全都回忆了一遍，却一无所获，都是未能找出与炼气一词相关的记忆。
这个陌生的词汇，第一次闯入了他的视线当中。
他低头喃喃自语道：
“难不成，这炼气一道，是只有顶顶尖的高手才能接触到的事物？”
content_en:
Below the dense forest.
Xiao Huohuo looked up.
The master he had just worshiped before him suddenly raised his head for some unknown reason and looked at the sky, with a trace of melancholy flashing in his eyes.
Just when he was puzzled, he suddenly saw his master come back to his senses.
The master stood with his hands behind his hands, his tone was faint, his eyes fell on him, and he seemed to sigh in anger:
"Hasn't been born for a long time."
"In the outside world, is there only the way of a warrior left?"
Hearing these melancholy words and looking at the aloof figure in front of him, Xiao Huohuo was suddenly shocked and his scalp went numb.
His eyes looking at Chu Feng were full of shock and disbelief, as if he had heard something that broke common sense.
Xiao Huohuo shook his head and doubted himself, even his words were a little confused:
"According to records, isn't this the way of warriors since ancient times?"
"Isn't it possible that besides being a warrior, is there any other way to practice in the world?"
He stared, waiting for the master's answer with some surprise.
Seeing the young man looking like this, Chu Feng felt happy.
Great, this guy took the bait.
The boy already believed 80% to 90% of these words.
His status as a worldly master will also become more solid in his eyes because of these subversive remarks.
Chu Feng's expression was still cold and aloof, but there was a slight disdainful chuckle at the corner of his mouth:
"The way of the world is divided into great ways and small ways."
"The way of martial arts is just a small way after all."
"Even if you live an extremely poor life, you will eventually be bound by its limitations and will not be able to truly reach the true peak."
"As you said, the limit of martial arts cultivation is only the so-called Grand Master state."
"The power you admire is just that one person can destroy an army, that's all."
That's it? !
These four words were like thunder on the ground, making the flute fire fire unable to recover for a long time.
What he looks up to, even the super powerful people who are admired by the entire Dongli City and the entire Southern Wilderness Realm, can only get this little evaluation in the eyes of the Master?
Thinking of this, Xiao Huohuo's breathing became a little rapid and his eyes shone.
Staring at the man in front of her.
The great master is nothing more than this, so what level is this master in front of him?
He couldn't imagine it.
Chu Feng coughed and continued:
"This small road is not worth mentioning in front of the main road."
Hearing this, Xiao Huohuo could no longer restrain his excitement:
"Master, what kind of cultivation method is that Great Dao, and what is the situation of those who practice the Great Dao?"
Seeing Xiao Huohuo getting more and more excited, Chu Feng smiled slightly and said:
"This great road is the way to refine qi."
"If you can enter the great realm, your so-called great master will be as mature and weak as a child in front of you."
The way to refine Qi?
Xiao Huohuo lowered his head and recited these four characters silently, and at the same time, he was constantly searching in his mind for information about the way to refine Qi.
But he recalled all the books he had read since he was a child and everything he had experienced, but he found nothing. He could not find any memory related to the word "qi refining".
This unfamiliar word broke into his sight for the first time.
He lowered his head and murmured:
"Is it possible that this Qi refining process is something that only top masters can access?"
title_en: Chapter 5 The way of practicing qi is also called cultivating immortals Chapter 6 Could it be that Master is an immortal
